summary_en: Fumakilla tendered all 283,350 shares of PALTAC held in a public tender offer by Medipal Holdings at 6,650 yen per share, recognizing an extraordinary gain of 1,585 million yen in the second quarter of fiscal year ending March 2027.
title_en: Notice Regarding Tender in Public Tender Offer and Recording of Extraordinary Gain (Investment Securities Selling Gain)
translation_en_brief:
On May 12, 2026, Fumakilla's board of directors resolved to tender all 283,350 ordinary shares of PALTAC held by the company in a public tender offer being conducted by Medipal Holdings. The decision followed a review of the offer terms, noting that PALTAC's board of directors had expressed its support for the transaction and that the terms would contribute to enhancing Fumakilla's corporate value.

Fumakilla tendered all shares at the offer price of 6,650 yen per share. The public tender offer period ran from May 12, 2026 through July 7, 2026, with settlement commencing on July 14, 2026. Upon successful completion of the tender and sale of all PALTAC shares held, Fumakilla recorded an extraordinary gain on investment securities sales of 1,585 million yen in the second quarter of fiscal year ending March 31, 2027.
